candidates.name: CallNtPowerInformation
verified_facts: Queries selected system power information levels
The output schema depends on the requested information level
semantic_limits: A successful query does not establish continuous uptime or canonical runner ownership.

candidates.name: Power Management Functions
verified_facts: Indexes Windows power-status, scheme, and system-power information functions
Read and mutation functions have different effects
semantic_limits: Documentation of power APIs does not itself prove a power-state readback was captured.

candidates.name: GetVolumeInformationByHandleW
verified_facts: Retrieves volume label, serial number, file-system name, and flags from a volume handle
A handle-based query ties results to the opened volume object
semantic_limits: Volume metadata is not a manufacturer disk serial and does not alone prove the canonical worktree path.

candidates.name: GetVolumePathNamesForVolumeNameW
verified_facts: Returns all path names for a specified volume GUID path
The result is a multi-string with explicit buffer sizing
semantic_limits: A path set can change and must be correlated with handles, file IDs, and capture time.

candidates.name: GetVolumePathNameW
verified_facts: Returns the volume mount-point root containing a specified path endpoint
The input must be a valid Win32 namespace path
semantic_limits: A resolved volume root does not prove the path is free of reparse-point or race conditions.

candidates.name: GetVolumeNameForVolumeMountPointW
verified_facts: Returns the volume GUID path associated with a mount point
The result can be used by volume-enumeration APIs
semantic_limits: A volume GUID mapping is not sufficient without exact file-handle and identity readback.

candidates.name: FindFirstVolumeW
verified_facts: Starts volume enumeration and returns the first volume GUID path
The returned search handle must be closed
semantic_limits: Enumeration order is not a stable identity and does not prove which volume hosts the canonical checkout.

candidates.name: FindNextVolumeW
verified_facts: Continues a volume enumeration started by FindFirstVolume
ERROR_NO_MORE_FILES marks enumeration completion
semantic_limits: A complete enumeration still requires path-to-volume and file-handle correlation.

candidates.name: FindFirstVolumeMountPointW
verified_facts: Starts mounted-folder enumeration for a specified volume
The result is relative to the supplied volume GUID path
semantic_limits: Mounted-folder enumeration does not by itself prove a target path resolves to the intended volume.

candidates.name: FindNextVolumeMountPointW
verified_facts: Continues mounted-folder enumeration for the same volume
The search handle comes from FindFirstVolumeMountPoint
semantic_limits: Enumeration results require capture-time and handle correlation to avoid stale path claims.

candidates.name: FindVolumeMountPointClose
verified_facts: Closes a mounted-folder search handle
The handle cannot be reused after close
semantic_limits: Correct handle cleanup does not prove the enumeration or receipt-validation result.

candidates.name: GetDiskFreeSpaceExW
verified_facts: Returns caller-available bytes, total bytes, and total free bytes
The 64-bit values must not be truncated
semantic_limits: Free-space values are volatile and cannot identify a volume or prove write durability.

candidates.name: GetFileInformationByHandle
verified_facts: Returns file information associated with an open handle
The structure includes volume serial and file index fields
semantic_limits: Handle identity must be captured before and after critical reads to detect replacement races.
